If the release is stuck pending or an image failed to pull, re-run `erun deploy --force` to rebuild and redeploy, or clear the pending release.
docker storage: the erun-dind sidecar — container erun-dind of deployment/team-devops in namespace team-dev, where this environment's image builds run and where its build images are stored
Running: Remove unused Docker images (the erun-dind sidecar)
audit: erun doctor --dry-run --prune-images team dev
trace-log: would append the full trace to <TMP>
==> Doctor team/dev
helm status team-devops --namespace team-dev --kube-context test-context
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev get pods -o wide
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
git-push-access-script:
  set -eu
  cd '<TMP>' 2>/dev/null || { printf 'remote=\n'; exit 0; }
  remote=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf 'remote=%s\n' "$remote"
  if [ -z "$remote" ]; then exit 0; fi
  case "$remote" in
    https://*|http://*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^[a-z]+://([^/]+)/.*#\1#') ;;
    git@*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^git@([^:]+):.*#\1#') ;;
    ssh://*) host=$(printf '%s' "$remote" | sed -E 's#^ssh://([^/@]+@)?([^/]+)/.*#\2#') ;;
    *) host="" ;;
  esac
  fetch_ok=0
  if git ls-remote --exit-code "$remote" HEAD >/dev/null 2>&1; then fetch_ok=1; fi
  printf 'fetch_ok=%s\n' "$fetch_ok"
  gh_auth=0
  gh_status=""
  if [ -n "$host" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    gh_status=$(gh auth status -h "$host" 2>&1) && gh_auth=1
  fi
  printf 'gh_authenticated=%s\n' "$gh_auth"
  push_credential=0
  if [ "$gh_auth" -eq 1 ]; then
    if printf '%s' "$gh_status" | grep -q "Token scopes:"; then
      if printf '%s' "$gh_status" | grep -q "'repo'"; then push_credential=1; fi
    else
      push_credential=1
    fi
  fi
  if [ "$push_credential" -eq 0 ] && { [ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ] || [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; }; then push_credential=1; fi
  if [ "$push_credential" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$host" ] && command -v ssh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    case "$remote" in
      git@*|ssh://*)
        ssh_exit=0
        ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -T "git@$host" >/dev/null 2>&1 || ssh_exit=$?
        if [ "$ssh_exit" -ne 255 ]; then push_credential=1; fi
        ;;
    esac
  fi
  printf 'push_credential=%s\n' "$push_credential"
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -c erun-devops deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
usage:
  set -eu
  cg=/sys/fs/cgroup
  cg_rel=$(awk -F: '$1=="0"{print $3; exit}' /proc/1/cgroup 2>/dev/null || true)
  case "$cg_rel" in
    ""|"/") ;;
    *) cg="$cg$cg_rel" ;;
  esac
  cg_type=""
  [ -f "$cg/cgroup.controllers" ] && cg_type=cgroup2fs
  printf 'cgroup_type=%s\n' "$cg_type"
  read_value() { [ -r "$1" ] && cat "$1" 2>/dev/null || true; }
  printf 'memory_current=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.current)"
  printf 'memory_max=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.max)"
  printf 'memory_peak=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.peak)"
  printf 'memory_oom_kill=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="oom_kill"{print $2}' $cg/memory.events 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'memory_ceiling_hits=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="max"{print $2}' $cg/memory.events 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'cpu_max=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/cpu.max)"
  cpu_usage_before=$(awk '$1=="usage_usec"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)
  time_before=$(awk '{printf "%.0f", $1*1000000000}' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true)
  sleep 1
  cpu_usage_after=$(awk '$1=="usage_usec"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)
  time_after=$(awk '{printf "%.0f", $1*1000000000}' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf 'cpu_usage_before=%s\n' "$cpu_usage_before"
  printf 'cpu_usage_after=%s\n' "$cpu_usage_after"
  printf 'cpu_time_before_ns=%s\n' "$time_before"
  printf 'cpu_time_after_ns=%s\n' "$time_after"
  printf 'cpu_periods=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="nr_periods"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'cpu_throttled_periods=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="nr_throttled"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'disk_workspace=%s\n' "$(df -Pk <HOME> 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || true)"
  printf 'disk_own_used_kb=%s\n' "$(timeout 30 du -sxk <HOME> 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -c erun-dind deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
usage-dind:
  set -eu
  cg=/sys/fs/cgroup
  cg_rel=$(awk -F: '$1=="0"{print $3; exit}' /proc/1/cgroup 2>/dev/null || true)
  case "$cg_rel" in
    ""|"/") ;;
    *) cg="$cg$cg_rel" ;;
  esac
  cg_type=""
  [ -f "$cg/cgroup.controllers" ] && cg_type=cgroup2fs
  printf 'cgroup_type=%s\n' "$cg_type"
  read_value() { [ -r "$1" ] && cat "$1" 2>/dev/null || true; }
  printf 'memory_current=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.current)"
  printf 'memory_max=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.max)"
  printf 'memory_peak=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/memory.peak)"
  printf 'memory_oom_kill=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="oom_kill"{print $2}' $cg/memory.events 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'memory_ceiling_hits=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="max"{print $2}' $cg/memory.events 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'cpu_max=%s\n' "$(read_value $cg/cpu.max)"
  cpu_usage_before=$(awk '$1=="usage_usec"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)
  time_before=$(awk '{printf "%.0f", $1*1000000000}' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true)
  sleep 1
  cpu_usage_after=$(awk '$1=="usage_usec"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)
  time_after=$(awk '{printf "%.0f", $1*1000000000}' /proc/uptime 2>/dev/null || true)
  printf 'cpu_usage_before=%s\n' "$cpu_usage_before"
  printf 'cpu_usage_after=%s\n' "$cpu_usage_after"
  printf 'cpu_time_before_ns=%s\n' "$time_before"
  printf 'cpu_time_after_ns=%s\n' "$time_after"
  printf 'cpu_periods=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="nr_periods"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'cpu_throttled_periods=%s\n' "$(awk '$1=="nr_throttled"{print $2}' $cg/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || true)"
  printf 'disk_workspace=%s\n' "$(df -Pk <HOME> 2>/dev/null | tail -n1 || true)"
  printf 'disk_own_used_kb=%s\n' "$(timeout 30 du -sxk <HOME> 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}' || true)"

doctor-inspect:
  set -eu
  printf '%s\n' '== Disk usage (/var/lib/docker) =='
  df -h /var/lib/docker
  printf '\n'
  printf '%s\n' '== Inode usage (/var/lib/docker) =='
  df -i /var/lib/docker
  printf '\n'
  printf '%s\n' '== Docker system df =='
  docker system df
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev wait --for=condition=Available --timeout 2m0s deployment/team-devops
kubectl --context test-context --namespace team-dev exec -c erun-dind deployment/team-devops -- /bin/sh -lc '<remote-script>'
doctor-prune_images:
  set -eu
  printf '%s\n' 'erun-doctor-read:before'
  docker system df --format '{{.Type}}|{{.Size}}|{{.Reclaimable}}'
  printf '%s\n' 'erun-doctor-read:before:end'
  docker image prune -a -f
  printf '%s\n' 'erun-doctor-read:after'
  docker system df --format '{{.Type}}|{{.Size}}|{{.Reclaimable}}'
  printf '%s\n' 'erun-doctor-read:after:end'
  printf '\n'
  printf '%s\n' '== Docker system df =='
  docker system df
==> Doctor done team/dev
